summary: A Session View audio track: plays the audio clips its track launches, warped to the song's tempo, and records takes from its input or the master.
use_for: An audio track for the Session View: play audio clips and record takes into them.
quirks: The work is done by the app's Session View engine (ReBuzz/Core/Session/SessionClipEngine.cs); the machine only hands it the block.
Outside the app's engine it passes its input through; with no clip launched it is silent, which is why its health is warn.
Clips are made in the Session View (dropping a file or session_clip_set), not by notes.
evidence: Machines/SessionClipPlayer/SessionClipPlayer.cs — the machine's source: two parameters and a hand-off to the Session View engine

parameters.name: Monitor
parameters.description: Hear the input: auto (while armed), in (always) or off
parameters.how: Chooses when you hear the input while this track is open to it: auto (only while the track is armed, the default), in (always) or off (never).
parameters.sound: At auto you monitor what you record; at in the input is always audible through the track; at off only the clips are heard.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: What a take records: the input, or the master output (resampling)
parameters.how: Chooses what a take records: in (the machines connected to this one, the default) or master (the song's own output, resampling).
parameters.sound: At in a take holds the connected source; at master it captures everything the song plays, to bounce or layer it.
